source.api: /api/simulations/{id}/impact — general simulation lifecycle (approximate / SPH / Delft3D demo engine, NOT the dedicated Ujjani dam-break scenario)

data_classification.counts: DERIVED IMPACT (spatial intersection of MODEL OUTPUT with REAL DATA) — not observed damage

roads.source: OpenStreetMap (roads_osm.geojson — curated road-network-only extract; 1955/1955 line features carry a `highway` tag, no waterway/railway/barrier geometry)

buildings.source: OpenStreetMap (osm_ujjani.gpkg, layer multipolygons, building IS NOT NULL)

settlements.source: OpenStreetMap (osm_ujjani.gpkg, layer points, place IS NOT NULL)
settlements.geometry_note: OSM place nodes (settlement centres), not census/administrative boundaries; a settlement counts as affected only when its representative point lies in the extent

population.nodata_handling: NoData / non-finite cells excluded from the sum (contribute nothing)
population.classification: DERIVED IMPACT (estimate) — modelled exposure to the modelled inundation extent; not people displaced / affected / casualties / surveyed
population.temporal_caveat: 2020 population estimate overlaid on a modelled flood extent; not the population present at the time of any specific past or future event

note: Counts are model-derived spatial intersections, not surveyed damage. status 'ok' with affected_count 0 means the modelled extent does not reach that asset class; status 'unavailable' means the dataset itself is missing.
